Place Light: story note Deika City.name: Place Light: story note Deika City

effects.instruction: Narrator only: since the battle against the Meta Liberation Army, a wide swath of Deika City is gone, decayed to dust by Tomura Shigaraki: flattened blocks that end in sharp edges, half-dissolved buildings, a damaged tower, and the untouched districts beyond, where survivors and relief crews work. Describe it that way, never as the intact city.
